Khaja Bandanawaz University (KBN University) is a private university located in Kalaburagi (Gulbarga), Karnataka, India, established under Karnataka Act No. 23 of 2018. It is managed by the Khaja Education Society, founded in 1958. KBN University offers diverse undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs across Medical Sciences, Engineering, Pharmacy, Nursing, Law, Arts, Science, and Commerce.

2. **Faculty of Medical Sciences**

6. **Faculty of Commerce & Management**

For details on individual degree programs, eligibility, and curriculum, please visit the academic sections on [kbn.university](https://www.kbn.university/).

patterns: is there an anti ragging committee
faqs.response: Yes, KBN University enforces a strict zero-tolerance policy towards ragging. The university has a dedicated Anti-Ragging Committee and Cell in compliance with UGC/statutory regulations to ensure a safe, inclusive campus environment.
